name: Black Gem Monstrosity
notes: The Black Gem Monstrosity is referred to as an unnamed "Laboratory-grown Atronach" in Atronach Needs and Allocations.
related_quests: Deadly Armaments: A regretful summoner needs help destroying arms and armor for the Worm Cult invasion of Solstice.
Pledge: Black Gem Foundry: Explore Black Gem Foundry and return Undaunted.
summary: The Black Gem Monstrosity is an Atronach composed of black soul gems that serves as the second main boss of the Black Gem Foundry.
